description: Read one House or Senate bill's official dossier. Large dossiers return an outline; re-call with one section and follow pagination.nextOffset for collections. Stages preserve nested records whole. Obtain billCode and session from canparl_search_bills; omitted session means the verified current official session.

billCode.description: Bill code from canparl_search_bills, including a split-bill suffix letter such as C-15A; accepts bill s321, S321, S 321, or S-321.

limit.description: Maximum whole records per selected collection page, 1–100 per call; larger values up to 10000 return 100 with a notice, and the byte budget may reduce it.

offset.description: Zero-based whole-record offset within the selected collection.

section.description: One section from the returned outline; omit for full dossier or overflow outline.

name: canparl_get_bill

chamber.description: Chamber of the latest completed major stage, or null; royal assent is reported as Senate.

name.description: Latest completed major stage name, or null.

latestMajorStage.description: Latest completed major stage, or null.

royalAssentDate.description: Royal assent as a UTC instant ending in Z (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fraction]Z), or null; a value in another shape is relayed as published.

divisions.description: House divisions, or null if unavailable.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_bill_section`: Unknown section selector or pagination supplied without a collection section. `unknown_session`: Malformed or unsupported official bill session. `invalid_bill_code`: Ambiguous or malformed bill code. `bill_not_found`: Official dossier has no matching record or returns a missing-record response. `upstream_blocked`: An official parliamentary source refuses the request with HTTP 403. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

kind.description: Absent for full dossier; outline lists sections; section returns one selection.

milestones.description: Reading milestones as UTC instants ending in Z (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fraction]Z); a value in another shape is relayed as published. Royal assent is bill.royalAssentDate.

houseFirstReading.description: House first reading date-time, or null.
